# $\mathrm{Cr}_n$ of a subfield of $\mathbb{C}$ is not generated by pseudo-regularizable elements for $n \ge 4$

Let $k$ be a subfield of $\mathbb{C}$ and let $n \ge 4$. The Cremona group
$\mathrm{Cr}_n(k)$, the group of birational automorphisms of affine $n$-space over $k$, is not
generated by its pseudo-regularizable elements.

This is Theorem 1.2 (2) of Lin and Shinder.

## Sources

- Hsueh-Yung Lin and Evgeny Shinder, *Motivic invariants of birational maps*, Annals of Mathematics 199 (2024), no. 1, 445–478. Statement taken from https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/AnnalsChallenge. Problem `annals_motivic_invariants` of the lean-eval benchmark.
